ownershipLaws: Every decoder/reader admission prefix retains its exact already-linked root on cancellation.
Reject a foreign payload, reader, proxy, reflected constructor or borrowed prototype before charge.
Recover the original child receipt after actual read-then-wrapper-throw; never reread or skip.
Quarantine actual parse-then-wrapper-throw with original exception and unchanged result authority.
Forward child blocked/rejected and 4096-byte terminal work; wrapper observation takes a later grant.
Reject 4097-byte child over-grant without hiding the raw count or unlinking the child.
One live destination page makes progress while source is incomplete; no fabricated EOF.
After actual detach/settle wrapper throws, recover from original private observation, never negative matcher.
Short/zero final grant does not unlink, refund or mint a terminal witness.
Cancellation after byte latch does not report copied completion or native/UI ACK.
Retired foreign reader/decoder cannot discharge the current original parent.
Result serial overflow and stale consume reject without replacing the outstanding scalar.
Unknown first fault stays charged; a second distinct thrown value is not silently discarded.
